The '''battle of the ''Vehemence''''' was fought between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Rebel [[Flight leader/Legends|Flight leader]] [[Wilkins]] started an attack run on the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vehemence (Star Destroyer)|''Vehemence'''s]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] and fired the [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. The explosions blinded Wilkins, and a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] accidentally rammed [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]], sending them both spinning through [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Wilkins and his [[Unidentified Rebel gunner|gunner]] were both knocked unconscious in the impact, so Wilkins' [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[BXET-R2]] took control and flied out of the [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] counterattack path. BX fired a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] at the bomber, which distracted it giving time for the Y-wing to escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
